[[Sand Drake]]s are found in some areas of the [[Crystal Desert]], usually in groups of two or three. Although being [[Earth Magic]] casters, they [[attack]] in [[melee]] range, efficiently using [[Ward Against Melee]] and [[Aftershock]].

==Notes==
*They seem to have an inherent 33% [[speed boost]] in [[normal mode]] that constantly has them moving faster than most players, which makes outrunning them nearly impossible.
**When [[Nicholas the Traveler]] is collecting Topaz Crests, [[Nicholas the Traveler/Dialogue#Diviner's Ascent (for 1 Topaz Crest)|his dialogue]] states ''"I was just discussing [[drake]]s with [[Professor Yakkington|my favorite companion]] here, because I've noticed how fast those things can move. Their speed quite astounds me."''
